_bug: EARLIER DRAFT - solver silently dropped the mandatory shop and reported 'optimal'.

infeasibility_reasons: Mandatory load 8 kW exceeds generator capacity 5 kW.
Generator capacity 5 kW is too small to power all mandatory shops (8 kW).

_what_was_wrong: The mandatory-shop constraint was a soft preference (high penalty, not a hard == 1), so the solver could drop the hospital_ward if its value-per-slot didn't quite justify the kW. The fix turned it into a hard equality constraint for every outage hour, then added a post-solve infeasibility check that emits human-readable reasons.
